_comment: Provisional M0 deck (GDD §5.1 [AMD], docs/M0_PLAN.md D1), carried into M1 with tags made live. Not a design commitment. Weight and Recovery are inherited from the class table in GDD §4.1 — a card never states them itself. M1 gives the deck its third axis: every card now carries exactly one of the six Weave tags (docs/M1_PLAN.md D15), so the Attunement roll has something to move. The tags are assigned to M0's seven cards rather than re-authored around them, which keeps this file a pure addition — same ids, same damage, same deck — and leaves the M0 golden log byte-identical. The spread that results is inherited, not designed: Physical and Fire carry three deck slots each because M0 repeated Lunge three times, while Shadow and Arcane carry one. Designing it is the job of the real 16-skill table GDD §5.1 still owes, where the tag is chosen with the card instead of after it.
_deckComment: Twelve cards, and the same Weight curve the twelve-distinct deck had: five Light, four Standard, two Heavy, one Ultimate. Repeats rather than near-duplicates — a second Lunge is another Lunge, which is honest, where a Strike was a Lunge you would never choose. The tag axis is what will eventually make twelve distinct cards honest instead: two Light single-target cards of different tags are two different answers once the Weave moves, which is exactly what M0 had no way to express.
